verdict.rationale: A desktop operating system could plausibly ship built-in AI assistance, as other desktop OSes do, so this axis applies to Fedora Workstation. The evidence pack has nothing on AI-generated insights or suggestions. It covers search, containers, virtual machines, and desktop utilities, none of which is AI analysis of user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
